name: transfasa-pro
description: TransFasa Pro — import & fleet operations platform (see docs/PRD-TransFasa-Pro.md)

scripts.dev: npm run build:functions && concurrently -n emu,web -c red,blue "npm run emulators" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:functions && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-transfasa --only auth,firestore,functions "vitest run --project integration"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-transfasa --only auth,firestore,functions "tsx scripts/seed-emulator.ts && playwright test --trace off"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && firebase hosting:channel:deploy staging --project staging
scripts.deploy:prod: echo 'Production deploy requires a human-approved tag (PRD §10.4).' && exit 1
